grades: Entering grades 9 to 12 (or a high school graduate of that year)
name: Point Park CSI Summer Camp
what_you_do: A week of crime scene work. You work a crime scene house and study fingerprints and hair clues with lab staff. You also tour the Allegheny County Medical Examiner and Jail.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12, or recent graduates. No experience needed. Residents must be at least 14 on the first day. Only the first 15 students who register and pay the deposit get in.
pay_detail: Tuition $750 plus $100 non-refundable registration fee ($850 commuter). Room and meals add $800 ($1,650 resident). Payment plans are available.
duration: 1 week. 2027 sessions: July 19 to 23 and July 26 to 30 (day or residential)
deadline_text: The 2027 sessions are July 19 to 23 and July 26 to 30, 2027. The page has a Register Here link but does not say if sign-ups have started. No deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Register online through CampDoc using the Register Here link on the camp page. Contact summercamps@pointpark.edu or 412-392-3456.
notes: Discounts: 30 percent off tuition for Point Park employees, alumni and immediate family, and $50 off for signing up more than one person or program. The schedule includes a firearm safety session. The schedule can change. The page banner still says 2026, but the page says its 2027 facts come first. It does not repeat the age 14 rule, the limit of 15 students, the tours or the firearm session, so ask the camp.
